blocks.zh: Section 0 — Introduction & Glossary of Terms | 導論與術語詞彙
blocks.en: Section 0 — Introduction & Glossary of Terms

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 TR49 的目的與範圍：為什麼生物技術製造需要有別於 TR29 的專屬清潔驗證指引，以及兩份文件之間的補充關係。
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and scope of TR49: why biotechnology manufacturing needs its own cleaning validation guidance distinct from TR29, and how the two documents complement each other.

blocks.zh: 辨識生物技術製造的三大製程類型：哺乳動物細胞培養（mammalian cell culture）、微生物發酵（microbial fermentation）及下游純化（downstream processing）。
blocks.en: Recognize the three main types of biotechnology manufacturing process: mammalian cell culture, microbial fermentation, and downstream processing.

blocks.zh: 掌握清潔驗證核心術語：包括 MAC（最大允許攜帶量）、MSSR（最大安全表面殘留量）、CIP（就地清洗）、COP（移出清洗）及 TOC（總有機碳）的定義與實務意義。
blocks.en: Master the core cleaning validation terms, including the definition and practical meaning of MAC (maximum allowable carryover), MSSR (maximum safe surface residue), CIP (clean-in-place), COP (clean-out-of-place), and TOC (total organic carbon).

blocks.zh: 了解生物技術清潔驗證的三大核心問題：獨特性、關鍵科學原則，及監管期望。
blocks.en: Understand the three core questions of biotech cleaning validation: what makes it unique, the key scientific principles, and regulatory expectations.

blocks.zh: 建立術語框架：能夠正確使用本報告所定義的詞彙，為後續章節的深入學習奠定基礎。
blocks.en: Build a terminology framework: be able to use the terms defined in this report correctly, as a foundation for the deeper study in later sections.

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: TR49 的定位：TR29 的生技專屬補充
blocks.en: Positioning of TR49: a biotech-specific supplement to TR29

blocks.zh: TR29 是清潔驗證的「通用教科書」，適用於所有製藥製造；TR49 則是針對生物技術藥品的專屬補充指引。兩者必須配合使用，不能互相取代。
blocks.en: TR29 is the "general textbook" of cleaning validation and applies to all pharmaceutical manufacturing; TR49 is a supplementary guide specific to biotechnology products. The two must be used together, and neither replaces the other.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，若廠內同時生產小分子（small molecule）與生技藥品（biotech），清潔驗證程序需分別參照 TR29 與 TR49 的不同要求。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, if a site manufactures both small molecules and biotech products, the cleaning validation program must refer to the different requirements of TR29 and TR49 respectively.

blocks.zh: 監管機構的期望升高
blocks.en: Rising regulatory expectations

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出：監管機構「increasingly expect（日益期望）」業者能科學論證清潔驗證方法，並維持持續改善。這意味著：
blocks.en: The original text states explicitly that regulators "increasingly expect" companies to justify their cleaning validation approach scientifically and to maintain continuous improvement. This means:

blocks.zh: 不能只說「我們一直這樣做」——需提供科學依據
blocks.en: It is not enough to say "we have always done it this way"; scientific justification must be provided

blocks.zh: 靜態的清潔驗證程序已不夠——需建立持續監測與回顧機制
blocks.en: A static cleaning validation program is no longer sufficient; ongoing monitoring and review mechanisms must be established

blocks.zh: 稽核時，稽核員會問「你如何知道這個方法是有效的？」
blocks.en: During an audit, the auditor will ask "How do you know this method is effective?"

blocks.zh: 比喻：廚房清潔 vs. 手術室清潔
blocks.en: Analogy: kitchen cleaning vs. operating room cleaning

blocks.zh: TR29 就像一般廚房清潔指南——適用於大多數情境。TR49 則像是專門針對手術室（生技藥品製造）設計的超高標準清潔規範，因為生技產品的殘留（蛋白質、核酸、活性生物體）比小分子化合物複雜得多，潛在風險也不同。
blocks.en: TR29 is like a general kitchen cleaning guide, suitable for most situations. TR49 is like an ultra-high-standard cleaning specification designed specifically for an operating room (biotech product manufacturing), because the residues of biotech products (proteins, nucleic acids, live organisms) are far more complex than those of small-molecule compounds, and the potential risks are different.

blocks.zh: 三類生技製造製程
blocks.en: Three types of biotech manufacturing process

blocks.zh: 哺乳動物細胞培養：如 CHO 細胞生產單株抗體（mAb）——殘留含有複雜蛋白質、培養基成分、病毒風險
blocks.en: Mammalian cell culture: for example, CHO cells producing monoclonal antibodies (mAb); residues contain complex proteins, culture medium components, and viral risk

blocks.zh: 微生物發酵：如大腸桿菌生產重組蛋白——殘留含有內毒素（endotoxin）問題更突出
blocks.en: Microbial fermentation: for example, E. coli producing recombinant proteins; endotoxin is a more prominent issue in the residues

blocks.zh: 下游純化：層析管柱、超濾膜——清潔困難度高，殘留分析方法需特別設計
blocks.en: Downstream processing: chromatography columns and ultrafiltration membranes; these are difficult to clean, and residue analytical methods need special design

blocks.zh: 術語深度解析
blocks.en: In-depth analysis of terminology

blocks.zh: 最重要的三組術語配對
blocks.en: The three most important term pairs

blocks.zh: 以下三組術語在清潔驗證中最常被混淆，務必釐清：
blocks.en: The following three pairs of terms are the ones most often confused in cleaning validation, so make sure you can tell them apart:

blocks.zh: LOD vs. LOQ：LOD（偵測下限）是「能不能偵測到」；LOQ（定量下限）是「能不能精確測量」。清潔驗證中，LOQ 更重要——因為我們需要準確知道殘留量是多少。
blocks.en: LOD vs. LOQ: LOD (limit of detection) answers "can it be detected?"; LOQ (limit of quantitation) answers "can it be measured accurately?" In cleaning validation, LOQ matters more, because we need to know accurately how much residue is present.

blocks.zh: MAC vs. MSSR：MAC（最大允許攜帶量）是基於下一批產品的劑量計算；MSSR（最大安全表面殘留量）是基於病患安全計算的設備表面限值。兩者都要計算，取較嚴格者。
blocks.en: MAC vs. MSSR: MAC (maximum allowable carryover) is calculated from the dose of the next product; MSSR (maximum safe surface residue) is the equipment surface limit calculated from patient safety. Both must be calculated, and the stricter one is used.

blocks.zh: CIP vs. COP：CIP（就地清洗）設備不拆開直接清洗，效率高但驗證難；COP（移出清洗）拆卸後清洗，可徹底但人力需求大。
blocks.en: CIP vs. COP: CIP (clean-in-place) cleans equipment without disassembly; it is efficient but harder to validate. COP (clean-out-of-place) cleans equipment after it is taken apart; it allows more thorough cleaning but is labor-intensive.

blocks.zh: 生技製造中「Soil（污染物）」的特殊性
blocks.en: The special nature of "soil" in biotech manufacturing

blocks.zh: 在生技製造中，Soil 遠比小分子藥廠複雜：
blocks.en: In biotech manufacturing, soil is far more complex than in a small-molecule plant:

blocks.zh: 蛋白質殘留：可能引發免疫原性（immunogenicity）——這正是 HAMA/HACA/HAHA 術語的來源
blocks.en: Protein residues: may trigger immunogenicity, which is the origin of the terms HAMA/HACA/HAHA

blocks.zh: 核酸殘留：宿主細胞 DNA 殘留有其安全限值（如 WHO 建議 <10 ng/劑）
blocks.en: Nucleic acid residues: residual host cell DNA has safety limits (for example, the WHO recommends <10 ng/dose)

blocks.zh: 內毒素（Endotoxin）：革蘭氏陰性菌發酵製程尤其需要關注
blocks.en: Endotoxin: requires particular attention in fermentation processes using Gram-negative bacteria

blocks.zh: 培養基成分：胺基酸、血清、促進劑等複雜混合物
blocks.en: Culture medium components: complex mixtures of amino acids, serum, growth promoters, and so on

blocks.zh: 比喻：Recovery（回收率）就像擦桌子後的驗收
blocks.en: Analogy: Recovery is like checking the table after wiping it

blocks.zh: 想像你用棉棒擦一張桌子，桌上原本有 100 個單位的殘留物，但你的棉棒只收集到 70 個單位——Recovery = 70%。
blocks.en: Imagine wiping a table with a swab. The table originally had 100 units of residue, but your swab collects only 70 units; Recovery = 70%.

blocks.zh: 在清潔驗證中，如果你的採樣方法 Recovery 只有 50%，而你設定的限值是 10 ppm，你必須確保實際偵測到的是 ≤5 ppm 才夠安全。回收率校正是計算真實殘留量的關鍵步驟。
blocks.en: In cleaning validation, if your sampling method has a Recovery of only 50% and your limit is 10 ppm, you must ensure that the amount actually detected is ≤5 ppm to be safe. Recovery correction is the key step in calculating the true amount of residue.

blocks.zh: 免疫原性相關術語：HAMA / HACA / HAHA
blocks.en: Immunogenicity-related terms: HAMA / HACA / HAHA

blocks.zh: 這三個術語都描述「患者對藥物中非人源成分產生的抗體反應」，是生技清潔驗證中殘留攜帶（Carryover）風險評估的重要依據：
blocks.en: These three terms all describe "the antibody response of a patient to non-human components in a drug", and are an important basis for carryover risk assessment in biotech cleaning validation:

blocks.zh: HAMA：針對鼠源（murine）成分——早期 mAb 藥物的主要問題
blocks.en: HAMA: directed against murine components; the main problem with early mAb drugs

blocks.zh: HACA：針對嵌合體（chimeric）成分
blocks.en: HACA: directed against chimeric components

blocks.zh: HAHA：針對人源化（humanized）成分——即便是「人源化」抗體也可能引發免疫反應
blocks.en: HAHA: directed against humanized components; even "humanized" antibodies can trigger an immune response

blocks.zh: 這些術語說明：即使是微量的蛋白質殘留攜帶，也可能因免疫原性而對患者造成嚴重影響。
blocks.en: These terms show that even a trace of protein carryover can seriously affect patients because of immunogenicity.

blocks.zh: Dirty Hold（髒放置時間）的實務意義
blocks.en: The practical meaning of Dirty Hold (dirty hold time)

blocks.zh: Dirty Hold 是設備用完後到開始清洗的等待時間。在生技製造中，這個時間段特別關鍵：
blocks.en: Dirty hold is the waiting time from the end of equipment use until cleaning begins. In biotech manufacturing, this period is especially critical:

blocks.zh: 蛋白質殘留在設備表面乾燥後，變性形成難以去除的薄膜
blocks.en: Protein residues dry on equipment surfaces and denature, forming a film that is difficult to remove

blocks.zh: 微生物在培養基殘留中大量增殖，增加 Bioburden 風險
blocks.en: Microorganisms multiply heavily in culture medium residues, increasing bioburden risk

blocks.zh: 因此，生技廠的 SOP 通常設定嚴格的 Dirty Hold 時間上限（如 ≤24 小時）
blocks.en: For this reason, biotech plant SOPs usually set a strict upper limit for dirty hold time (for example, ≤24 hours)

blocks.zh: 練習思考 1：術語應用
blocks.en: Exercise 1: Applying the terminology

blocks.zh: 情境：你的 CHO 細胞培養槽剛完成一批單株抗體生產。清洗後，你用棉棒採樣，TOC 分析顯示表面殘留為 3.2 µg/cm²，而你的 MSSR 計算結果為 5.0 µg/cm²。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your CHO cell culture vessel has just completed a batch of monoclonal antibody production. After cleaning, you take a swab sample, and TOC analysis shows a surface residue of 3.2 µg/cm², while your calculated MSSR is 5.0 µg/cm².

blocks.zh: 問題：這次清洗是否符合標準？如果採樣的 Recovery 只有 80%，你的判斷是否改變？
blocks.en: Question: Does this cleaning meet the standard? If the sampling Recovery is only 80%, does your conclusion change?

blocks.zh: 提示：校正後實際殘留 = 偵測值 ÷ Recovery = 3.2 ÷ 0.8 = 4.0 µg/cm²，仍在 MSSR 5.0 以內，符合標準。
blocks.en: Hint: Corrected actual residue = detected value ÷ Recovery = 3.2 ÷ 0.8 = 4.0 µg/cm², which is still within the MSSR of 5.0, so it meets the standard.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 2：術語辨別
blocks.en: Exercise 2: Distinguishing terms

blocks.zh: 以下哪種情境更需要優先考慮 Immunogenicity 風險？
blocks.en: Which of the following scenarios should give higher priority to immunogenicity risk?

blocks.zh: 小分子化學藥廠，相鄰批次為不同劑量的同一 API
blocks.en: A small-molecule chemical plant, with adjacent batches of the same API at different doses

blocks.zh: 生技廠，同一設備先後生產鼠源 mAb（Product A）和人源化 mAb（Product B）
blocks.en: A biotech plant, where the same equipment manufactures a murine mAb (Product A) followed by a humanized mAb (Product B)

blocks.zh: 生技廠，同一設備連續生產相同的重組蛋白
blocks.en: A biotech plant, where the same equipment continuously manufactures the same recombinant protein

blocks.zh: 答案：B。鼠源蛋白的 HAMA 殘留攜帶至 Product B 批次中，可能引發患者的免疫反應，且因 Product A/B 之蛋白質結構不同，無法以相同 HAMA 抗體相互抵消。
blocks.en: Answer: B. Carryover of HAMA-inducing murine protein residue into the Product B batch may trigger an immune response in patients, and because the protein structures of Product A and Product B differ, the same HAMA antibodies cannot offset each other.

blocks.zh: Section 0 Summary | 本節重點總結
blocks.en: Section 0 Summary

blocks.zh: Key Takeaways — 核心要點
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: TR49 補充 TR29，專為生技製造清潔驗證設計
blocks.en: TR49 supplements TR29 and is designed specifically for cleaning validation in biotech manufacturing

blocks.zh: 生技製造涵蓋細胞培養、發酵、下游純化三大類型
blocks.en: Biotech manufacturing covers three main types: cell culture, fermentation, and downstream purification

blocks.zh: MAC 與 MSSR 是清潔驗證限值計算的核心工具
blocks.en: MAC and MSSR are the core tools for calculating cleaning validation limits

blocks.zh: Recovery 校正是確保採樣結果有效性的必要步驟
blocks.en: Recovery correction is an essential step to ensure sampling results are valid

blocks.zh: Dirty Hold 時間需在 SOP 中明確管控
blocks.en: Dirty hold time must be clearly controlled in the SOP

blocks.zh: Key Terms to Remember — 必記術語
blocks.en: Key Terms to Remember

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證 (Cleaning Validation) — 有文件佐證的高保證度清潔程序
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation: documented evidence providing a high degree of assurance that a cleaning procedure is effective

blocks.zh: 最大允許攜帶量 (MAC) — 批次間殘留攜帶的最高允許量
blocks.en: Maximum Allowable Carryover (MAC): the maximum amount of residue allowed to carry over between batches

blocks.zh: 就地清洗 (CIP) vs. 移出清洗 (COP)
blocks.en: Clean-in-Place (CIP) vs. Clean-out-of-Place (COP)

blocks.zh: 總有機碳 (TOC) — 非專屬性分析方法
blocks.en: Total Organic Carbon (TOC): a non-specific analytical method

blocks.zh: 最差情況 (Worst Case) — 挑戰性最高的清潔驗證條件
blocks.en: Worst Case: the most challenging conditions for cleaning validation
